title: Personal Data Processing Policy
intro1: This Personal Data Processing Policy (hereinafter - "Policy") describes the procedure and conditions for processing personal data of users of the JETSIM digital service, including to the extent provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
intro2: The Policy is developed in accordance with:
intro_list1: Federal Law No. 152-FZ dated July 27, 2006 "On Personal Data";
intro_list2: Federal Law No. 149-FZ dated July 27, 2006 "On Information, Information Technologies and Information Protection";
intro_list3: Law of the Russian Federation No. 2300-1 dated February 7, 1992 "On Protection of Consumer Rights";
intro_list4: other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation,
intro_list5: as well as taking into account the specifics of the JETSIM digital service.
important_text: JETSIM is not a communications operator within the meaning of Article 2 of Federal Law No. 126-FZ dated July 7, 2003 "On Communications" and does not provide telecommunications services in the territory of the Russian Federation. The service's activities represent the provision of information and organizational services for arranging Users' access to digital eSIM profiles of foreign operators providing communications outside the Russian Federation.
intro3: This Policy is an integral part of the JETSIM Public Offer and applies when using the JETSIM Website and Software in the territory of the Russian Federation.

section1_text: The Policy applies to all personal data processing operations carried out by the Operator within the framework of the www.jetsim.ru JETSIM website in the Russian Federation and JETSIM Software (mobile and web interfaces), as well as when interacting through service support channels.
section2_jetsim: "JETSIM" is a digital platform that provides Users with the ability to register and activate digital profiles (eSIM) and access related services for use outside the Russian Federation.
section2_software: "JETSIM Software" is any software distributed under the JETSIM brand, including but not limited to mobile applications, web interfaces and software modules designed to activate and manage the functionality of JETSIM services.
section2_services: "Services" - the activity of the Operator to provide the User with complete and reliable information about the conditions, Tariffs and device compatibility with eSIM, as well as to arrange the User's access to JETSIM digital profiles (eSIM) in accordance with the selected Tariff.
section2_website: "JETSIM Website" is the official Internet resource available at www.jetsim.ru
section2_user: "User" is an individual with full legal capacity who has reached 18 years of age, registered on the JETSIM platform, created an account and accepted the Public Offer.
section2_pd: "Personal Data (PD)" is any information relating to a directly or indirectly identified individual.
section2_processing: "Personal Data Processing" is any action with PD: collection, recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, clarification, use, transfer, depersonalization, blocking, deletion, destruction.
section2_partners: "Partners/Processors" are persons acting on behalf of the Operator under PD processing agreements (Russian payment providers, hosting/IT support providers, analytics services with local processing, etc.).
section3_text: We process the following categories of User data:
section3_ident_text: Full name, phone number, email, country of intended eSIM use; account data (ID, login, login history).
section3_orders_text: selected tariffs/packages, order and activation history; payment information (status, amount, date/time, masked details).
section3_orders_note: We do not store full payment card details; processing is carried out by a payment provider in Russia.
section3_technical_text: IP address, device and browser parameters, interface language, cookies and other identifiers; action logs in the interface (date/time, event type).
section3_support_text: request content, attachments (if any), contact channel.
section3_special_text: are not requested or processed. Please do not provide such information through the service forms.
section4_title: 4. Purposes and Legal Basis for Processing
section4_text: We process PD strictly to the extent necessary to achieve the following purposes:
section4_contract_text: account registration, order placement, providing access to eSIM profiles and related services; invoicing and payment processing, generating receipts/closing documents; informing about order/activation status, service notifications.
section4_law_text: accounting/tax accounting, responding to lawful requests from government agencies, fulfilling consumer protection obligations, handling claims.
section4_security_text: incident monitoring, fraud and abuse prevention, maintaining event logs and audits.
section4_marketing_text: mailings about products and promotions through channels marked by the User (opt-out option - see section 11).
section4_analytics_text: aggregated usage statistics, A/B tests, interface research. Data is depersonalized where possible; when using cookies, see section 9.
section5_list1: data is provided by the User themselves during registration/order placement/contacting support;
section5_list2: technical data is collected automatically when using the website/applications through cookies and logging;
section5_list3: payment statuses from Russian payment providers/banks through secure channels.
section6_title: 6. Localization and Storage Locations of PD
section6_text: Primary recording, systematization, accumulation and storage of PD of Russian citizens are carried out in a database on the territory of the Russian Federation. For certain tasks (email mailings, analytics, service integrations), processors may be used that carry out subsequent processing outside the Russian Federation - subject to the conditions of section 7 (cross-border transfer).
section7_text: Transfer of PD outside the Russian Federation is possible subject to the requirements of Article 12 of 152-FZ:
section7_list1: to countries that ensure adequate protection of the rights of PD subjects; or
section7_list2: with the User's separate consent (Appendix No. 2); or
section7_list3: if the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract with the User or at their initiative (registration and activation of eSIM abroad); or
section7_list4: in other cases expressly provided for by law.
section7_text2: Before cross-border transfer, we assess the level of protection in the receiving jurisdiction and ensure contractual obligations of processors regarding confidentiality and security.
section8_text: We engage processors only if there is an agreement providing for the purposes, scope and measures for PD protection. Possible categories of processors include:
section8_list1: payment aggregators and banks of the Russian Federation;
section8_text2: The list of key processors and their details may be published on the website in a separate section.
section8_text3: We do not sell personal data to third parties.
section9_text: We use necessary cookies (for authorization and shopping cart/order functionality) and, with User's consent, functional/analytical/marketing cookies. Cookie settings are available in the website/application interface and in browser settings. Refusing optional cookies does not affect basic functionality but may limit personalization.
section9_text2: Information about types of cookies, their terms and purposes of use is published in Appendices No. 1, No. 2, No. 3 to this policy.
section10_text: We store PD no longer than necessary for processing purposes, unless longer periods are provided for by law or contract. Typical periods:
section10_list1: account data - for the period of account validity and 1 year after deletion (for claim settlement and rights protection);
section10_list2: order and payment data - in accordance with accounting/tax accounting requirements (usually 5 years);
section10_list4: marketing contacts - until consent is withdrawn or 2 years of inactivity.
section10_text2: After the expiration of periods, data is deleted or depersonalized.
section11_title: 11. User Rights and Methods of Their Implementation
section11_text: The User has the right to:
section11_list1: receive information about the processing of their PD;
section11_list2: demand clarification, blocking or destruction of PD if they are incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, unlawfully obtained or not needed for the stated purpose;
section11_list3: withdraw consent to PD processing (including marketing mailings (Appendix No. 1) - through the personal account/unsubscribe link/contacting us;
section11_list4: appeal the actions/inaction of the Operator to Roskomnadzor or court.
section11_text3: Response period - up to 10 days from the date of receipt of the request.
section12_text: We apply legal, organizational and technical measures provided for by Article 19 of 152-FZ and by-laws, including:
section12_list1: access rights separation and access management;
section12_list2: encryption of communication channels and data during transmission;
section12_list4: assessment of processors' compliance with confidentiality and information security requirements;
section12_text2: The security regime and requirements for ISPD are fixed in the Operator's internal documents.
section13_text: The service is intended for persons 18+. We do not knowingly collect children's PD. If such processing is identified, we will delete the data upon request from a legal representative. Please do not send through the service forms documents containing health information, biometric data and other special categories of PD.
section14_text1: We may periodically update this Policy. The current version is published on the website and comes into force from the moment of its placement, unless another effective date is specified in the version itself.
section14_text2: When making significant changes to personal data processing conditions (including changes to purposes, categories of processed data, methods and grounds for transfer, circle of recipients and other conditions), we will notify Users about this by available means, including notification in the personal account, through the mobile application or by email.
section14_text3: If changes affect processing grounds requiring consent, or expand the volume of processed data, the Operator will ensure obtaining new User consent before continuing processing.
